ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous regions of high-intensity white pixels located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; these regions transition into a solid low-intensity black area at the center and base of the fluke; the white regions contain high-frequency dark mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 130 degrees and a depth-to-span ratio of approximately 0.05.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, with several distinct jagged peaks and valleys (amplitude > 5 pixels) visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges of both lobes, sweeping upward to sharp points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of small, circular dark pixel clusters (mottling) distributed across the white-pigmented distal regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular tissue loss and chipping observed along the distal trailing edges of both lobes, creating a jagged profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt and pepper' pigmentation pattern on the distal tips where individual low-intensity pixels are isolated within the high-intensity white regions.
